blocks.raw: # mPulse Documentation
blocks.text: mPulse Documentation

blocks.raw: > mPulse is ​Akamai​'s real user measurement solution that maps user behavior to business performance as it's happening. With mPulse you can collect detailed business and performance data directly from your users' browser or mobile application in real time, and then drill down for a closer look at the performance of all your resources across all of your page views to identify the root cause of latencies and lost revenue.
